_comment: Contract registry for StonkFlyRH. Copy to tokens.json.
The Uniswap addresses below are Robinhood Chain (4663) deployments as listed in
and sdk-core's CHAIN_TO_ADDRESSES_MAP), which agree with each other. USDG is the
address Blockscout lists for Global Dollar. They were NOT confirmed against the
chain from inside this repository: run `python -m stonkflyrh chain verify` before
any run. It refuses an address with no code, a router and quoter that disagree
about their factory, a token whose on-chain symbol or decimals differ from this
file, and any pair with no pool at its fee tier. Check them on
The quote asset is USDG (6 decimals — verify confirms). Every memecoin is traded
against it, so dollar limits need no conversion. 'weth' is only used to value gas.
Memecoin addresses are yours to fill in. pool_fee is the Uniswap v3 tier in
hundredths of a bip: 500, 3000 or 10000. A Pons launch graduates into a 1% pool.
